news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems CEO and Director Exercise Stock Options
news.summary: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercised a fully-vested option for 1,402 shares at a $0.75 strike on July 22, and director Richard S. Kollender exercised options for 3,508 shares at the same price on July 24, ahead of the options' expiration; no shares were sold in either filing.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems confirmed it will report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 7, 2026, followed by a management webcast conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 60,000 restricted stock units of Class A common stock to a newly hired employee as a material inducement to employment, with the award vesting in three equal annual installments.

news.headline: KeyBanc Cuts Rapid Micro Biosystems Price Target to $5, Maintains Overweight Rating
news.summary: KeyBanc analyst Paul Knight reduced his price target on RPID to $5 from $8 while maintaining an Overweight rating, following the company's dilutive May equity and warrant offering.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Pricing of Up to Approximately $32 Million Underwritten Offering
news.summary: Existing investor Bain Capital Life Sciences and healthcare-focused Armistice Capital priced a dilutive offering of Class A common stock and Series A/B warrants at $1.955 per unit, raising roughly $9.8M upfront with potential proceeds of up to about $32M if all warrants are exercised.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q1 2026 revenue grew 11% year-over-year to $8.0 million on 6 Growth Direct system placements (versus 3 a year earlier) and roughly 30% recurring-revenue growth, beating consensus, but the net loss widened versus expectations; the company reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance of $37M-$41M revenue and 30-38 placements.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems will report second-quarter 2026 results before market open with an 8:30 a.m. ET webcast; investors will watch system placement pace, cash burn, and progress toward full-year guidance.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue and placement guidance
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to $37M-$41M total revenue and 30-38 Growth Direct system placements for 2026 with roughly 20% gross margin; Q2 results will show whether the company is tracking to this range after a Q1 beat on revenue but a wider-than-expected net loss.

catalysts.label: MilliporeSigma distribution agreement, year two
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro is in year two of its five-year global co-exclusive distribution and collaboration agreement with MilliporeSigma (running roughly March 2026-February 2027), under which MilliporeSigma has a stated commitment to purchase Growth Direct systems; incremental orders under this plan year are a potential upside catalyst.

catalysts.label: Follow-on orders from anchor pharma accounts
catalysts.detail: Following large multi-system expansion orders from Amgen (Q4 2025) and Samsung Biologics (Q1 2026), additional follow-on orders from these and other big-pharma customers as they continue rolling out Growth Direct across sites remain a potential upside catalyst.

pulse: RPID remains a deeply out-of-favor micro-cap, trading in roughly the $1.85-$2.10 range through June and July after touching 52-week lows near $1.86, still weighed down by the dilutive ~$9.8M (up to ~$32M with warrants) May financing from Bain Capital Life Sciences and Armistice Capital that prompted KeyBanc to cut its target to $5 while keeping an Overweight rating; consensus among the handful of covering analysts remains a bullish 'Strong Buy' with targets spanning $5-$8. Operationally the story is one of steady but uneven progress: Q1 2026 revenue rose 11% to $8.0M on record system placements and the company reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $37M-$41M revenue, yet the net loss widened, and news flow since has been light and largely routine (a June employee inducement grant, July insider option exercises by the CEO and a director, and confirmation of the Q2 reporting date). The next major catalyst is the Q2 2026 earnings report on August 7, 2026, which will test whether placement momentum, the MilliporeSigma distribution ramp, and cost discipline are translating into progress toward full-year targets and easing investor concern over cash burn and further dilution.
